	desc = eu4_2k_elections.2.d
	picture = ELECTION_REPUBLICAN_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_competitive_politics }
	option = {
		name = eu4_2k_elections.2.a
		# Incumbent threshold = surge share + incumbent score; the rest is the opposition.
		set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_surge_score value = 5 }
		set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = 55 }
		if = { limit = { stability = 2 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { stability = 0 } } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = -15 } }
		if = { limit = { war_exhaustion = 5 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = -15 } }
		if = { limit = { num_of_loans = 1 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = -10 } }
		if = { limit = { corruption = 5 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = -10 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 2 } } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = -15 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_campaign_economy NOT = { num_of_loans = 1 } }
					AND = { has_country_flag = eu4_2k_campaign_security OR = { is_at_war = yes army_size_percentage = 0.9 } }
					has_country_flag = eu4_2k_campaign_unity
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = 10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { average_unrest = 2 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_surge_score value = 10 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { corruption = 10 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_surge_score value = 10 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { war_exhaustion = 8 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_surge_score value = 10 } change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold value = 10 } }
		random_list = {
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 0 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 5 } }

			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 40 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 45 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 50 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 55 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 60 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 65 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 70 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 75 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 80 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 85 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 90 } }
			5 = { set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll value = 95 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll which = eu4_2k_surge_score } } }
			eu4_2k_surge_takes_power = yes
			set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 1 }
			define_ruler = { }
			country_event = { id = eu4_2k_elections.5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = eu4_2k_election_roll which = eu4_2k_incumbent_threshold } } }
			# After two terms the governing bloc renews its leadership.
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 2 } } define_ruler = { } }
			change_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = eu4_2k_elections.3 }
		}
		else = {
			eu4_2k_opposition_takes_power = yes
			# Also covers generic countries where both sides are a governing coalition.
			set_variable = { which = eu4_2k_terms value = 1 }
			define_ruler = { }
			country_event = { id = eu4_2k_elections.4 }
		}
		clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_campaign_economy
		clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_campaign_security
		clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_campaign_unity
		clr_country_flag = eu4_2k_election_pending
		eu4_2k_schedule_next_election = yes
	}
}
